# FG-KNOW-0007

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 500 |
| 重大度 | warn |
| Runbook | [`knowledge`](../../ops/runbooks/knowledge.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `notes_provision_failure_writes_no_pointer` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: ノートを作れませんでした。管理者に問い合わせ番号を伝えてください。
- en: Your notes could not be created. Give the request ID to your administrator.
- id: Catatan Anda tidak dapat dibuat. Berikan ID permintaan kepada administrator Anda.

## 原因 (cause)

Plan 20 N1 (ADR-0040 §6): `POST /api/v1/user/notes` created the private project `<user>/notes`, but a later step failed, so the pointer (forge.user_notes) was NOT written: `step=provision` (the repository could not be created or marked ready), `step=seed` (the first commit with `.forge/doctypes/note.yml` and `README.md` could not be written, or `main` already existed), `step=link` (the pointer could not be written — also when a concurrent request linked other notes first, chained FG-KNOW-0006). The cause is chained (FG-GIT-*, FG-REPO-*, FG-DB-*).

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `step`, `user_id`, `notes_project_id` (the half-made project), `repo_id` and the chained code, with the request_id. The project exists and is private (only its creator reads it); `SELECT * FROM forge.user_notes WHERE project_id = <id>` returns nothing.

## 対処 (fix)

Fix the chained cause (runbooks repository-provisioning, git-process-failed, db-unavailable). Then the person deletes the half-made project (it holds the path `notes`) and creates the notes again. Runbook knowledge, 「Personal notes」.
